title: Generalized Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetry and Euclidean equality rigidity

abstractEnglish: We resolve the generalized Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetric conjecture in every dimension. In a complete simply connected smooth manifold with sectional curvature at most κ ≤ 0, every finite-volume set of finite ambient perimeter has perimeter at least that of the equal-volume ball in curvature κ. For bounded positive-volume sets, equality in the Euclidean comparison holds precisely when the set agrees up to null sets with an open region isometric, with its induced metric, to a round Euclidean ball.
titleEn: Generalized Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetry and Euclidean equality rigidity
titleZh: 广义Cartan–Hadamard等周不等式与欧氏等号刚性

details.overview: 该稿件研究截面曲率非正完备单连通流形中的等周不等式。作者声称在所有维数解决广义Cartan–Hadamard等周猜想：曲率至多κ≤0时，每个有限体积、有限周边长的集合，其周长至少不小于曲率κ下同体积球的周长；对有界正体积集合，欧氏比较中的等号成立当且仅当该集合（至零测集）与一个欧氏球等距。该结果给出等周比较及刚性刻画。但手稿为AI产生，未经独立审查或同行评议。
